label: Tech support
intent: Tech support fixes the computer: a monitor with a spanner on its screen. Light: the spanner cranks clockwise round the bolt in its head and stops dead as it tightens, holds a beat, then swings back and settles. Strong: the spanner winds back first, then cranks the bolt twice, each crank stopping dead, before it swings back and settles.

spanner.//: an open ring head round the bolt, and the handle
the spanner turns about the bolt in its head
